title: Finally banked that sweet AMD profit!
author: VeroLeaf
selftext: Got out of AMD right at 485.971, locking in a solid $596 realized gain over yesterday's trade. No more position on this name now but that win hits different after riding the recent AI chip momentum. Anyone else also taking quick, tidy profits on AMD runs instead of holding through the chop? That green P/L screen never gets old.

comments.author: D-DH-t-t-t-t-t
comments.body: I used to hold AMD, but I was too scared of losing, so I sold it with just a small profit.
